description: Electric utility balance-sheet skeleton for SIC 4911 retaining 212 supplied US GAAP concepts once. The supplied Duke Energy presentation guides classified presentation; official definitions govern metadata and specific classification. Hierarchy and shared groups imply no arithmetic.
classification_notes: The 212-concept SIC inventory covers multiple issuers; Duke Energy is a presentation reference, not evidence that it reports every concept.

Current/noncurrent layout follows the reference, with utility-specific regulatory, plant, fuel and decommissioning categories preserved. No unsupported reference presentation subtotal or net debt is manufactured.
Utility and general PP&E views overlap. Nuclear fuel held as PP&E differs from energy inventory. Construction, fuel, accumulated depreciation and net property require matched measurement scope.

RegulatoryAssets and RegulatoryLiabilities can describe individual schedule items; do not infer reported totals. Securitized transition assets and recoverable deferred fuel costs can be included in regulatory assets.
Decommissioning trust assets and fund investments can overlap and differ in disclosure measurement. Funding assets do not automatically offset ARO.
Unsuffixed derivative/hedge asset and liability definitions can explicitly be current. Collateral rights and obligations require separate maturity and master-netting review.
Maturity-unspecified balances remain outside classified subtotals; explicit current deferred finance costs with unresolved asset versus debt-deduction presentation remain candidates.
Group notes describe shared overlap issues; individual review reasons identify concept-specific scope, measurement or classification uncertainties.
All nodes use aggregation_policy none. Contra flags do not prescribe sign inversion or another deduction from reported net balances. Missing facts are not zero.

metadata_contract.period_type: 211 instant concepts and one duration concept (options forfeited), checked against official US GAAP 2026.
metadata_contract.unit_type: 198 monetary, 11 shares and 3 per-share concepts; currency and scale follow source facts.
metadata_contract.contra: True for accumulated depreciation/amortization, credit allowances and treasury carrying costs; no automatic sign inversion.

taxonomy_reference.note: Metadata and definitions checked against official 2026 schema and documentation. Historical filings retain their own taxonomy versions and units.

sources.description: 212 unique user-supplied US GAAP concepts for SIC 4911.
Official FASB 2026 schema and documentation retained locally.

children.label: Current cash and securities
children.classification_note: Cash and equivalents are components of combined cash/equivalents. Short-term investments and marketable securities overlap; no unsupported cash-plus-investment subtotal is created.

children.label: Cash and cash equivalents at carrying value
Current restricted cash and deposits
children.classification_note: Restricted cash/investments can contain cash-only balances and posted deposits; confirm fund scope and cash treatment.

concepts.name: us-gaap:RestrictedCashAndInvestmentsCurrent
concepts.review_reason: Current restricted cash and investments can include restricted cash-only and investment balances; choose a reconciled aggregate or its components.

children.label: Current receivable views
children.classification_note: Total, accounts-plus-other, trade gross/net, unbilled and other receivables are overlapping presentations. Allowances are already reflected in corresponding net values; no automatic gross-to-net calculation.

children.label: Accounts and other receivables net current
Allowance for doubtful accounts receivable current

concepts.name: us-gaap:AllowanceForDoubtfulAccountsReceivableCurrent
concepts.review_reason: This current trade-receivable allowance is already reflected in net current trade receivables; it is not an additional deduction from the net amount.

children.label: Allowance for doubtful other receivables current

concepts.name: us-gaap:AllowanceForDoubtfulOtherReceivablesCurrent
concepts.review_reason: The current other-receivable allowance applies to a different portfolio from the current trade allowance; establish which net other receivable amount already includes it.

children.label: Current contract assets
children.classification_note: Conditional contract assets differ from unconditional receivables and may overlap reported unbilled balances only after reconciliation.

children.label: Contract with customer asset net current
Inventory views
children.classification_note: Net total inventory, energy inventory, utility schedule types and fuel/material components overlap. Gross raw materials differ from amounts net of reserves; nuclear fuel held as PP&E remains outside inventory.

concepts.name: us-gaap:PublicUtilitiesInventory
concepts.review_reason: PublicUtilitiesInventory is an inventory type in a utility schedule rather than necessarily total inventory; identify the commodity or supplies population.

children.label: Energy related inventory natural gas in storage
Energy related inventory other fossil fuel

concepts.name: us-gaap:InventoryRawMaterialsAndSupplies
concepts.review_reason: Raw materials and supplies are gross before reserves, unlike the net-of-reserves alternative; do not substitute one measurement for the other.

children.label: Inventory raw materials and supplies net of reserves
Current regulatory assets
children.classification_note: Recoverable current regulatory costs can contain deferred fuel costs. Regulation may also generate individual schedule facts; do not infer aggregate status from a concept name.

concepts.name: us-gaap:RegulatoryAssetsCurrent
concepts.review_reason: Current regulatory assets can contain recoverable deferred fuel costs and other regulated balances; identify exclusions before adding those narrower assets.

concepts.name: us-gaap:DeferredFuelCost
concepts.review_reason: Deferred fuel costs are current recoverable regulated costs under the official definition and may already be included in current regulatory assets.

children.label: Current derivative assets
children.classification_note: Both current derivative asset concepts are explicitly current under official definitions; measurement/netting scope must be reconciled before using them as alternatives.

concepts.name: us-gaap:DerivativeInstrumentsAndHedges
concepts.review_reason: Despite its unsuffixed name, the official definition explicitly identifies current derivative and hedge assets; reconcile scope with DerivativeAssetsCurrent.

children.label: Current prepaids and residual assets
children.classification_note: Combined prepaid/other assets can contain prepaid insurance, other prepayments and the separate residual. Classify prepaid insurance as current under its definition.

children.label: Prepaid expense and other assets current
Current disposal assets
children.classification_note: Assets held for sale outside a disposal group differ from disposal-group assets. Reclassification can remove balances from earlier asset categories.

children.label: Assets held for sale not part of disposal group current
Noncurrent investments
children.classification_note: Long-term and other long-term investments may include equity-method and marketable holdings. Distinguish disjoint portfolios before combining.

children.label: Decommissioning and other trust assets
children.classification_note: Decommissioning trust fair-value disclosures and decommissioning fund investments can describe the same holdings; broader trust assets may also contain those funds.

concepts.name: us-gaap:DecommissioningTrustAssetsAmount
concepts.review_reason: This is fair value of decommissioning trust investments and may be only a parenthetical or footnote disclosure; confirm recognition and overlap with decommissioning fund investments.

concepts.name: us-gaap:DecommissioningFundInvestments
concepts.review_reason: Decommissioning fund investments can include the trust assets measured separately at fair value; reconcile fund coverage and measurement before treating the amounts as distinct holdings.

children.label: Ppe and utility asset views
children.classification_note: General PP&E, utility PP&E and combined PP&E/finance ROU populations overlap. Gross, net and accumulated amounts are alternative measurement views, not additive asset categories.

children.label: General ppe
children.classification_note: Net PP&E already reflects its accumulated DD&A. Construction and other PP&E can be components of gross property.

concepts.name: us-gaap:AccumulatedDepreciationDepletionAndAmortizationPropertyPlantAndEquipment
concepts.review_reason: Accumulated PP&E DD&A can include the public-utility depreciation deduction; net PP&E already reflects the matching accumulated balance.

children.label: Property plant and equipment other net
Utility ppe
children.classification_note: Utility plant-in-service documentation describes gross PP&E; establish construction inclusion. Fuel PP&E, nuclear fuel net and other utility PP&E may overlap; net amounts already reflect depreciation/amortization.

concepts.name: us-gaap:PublicUtilitiesPropertyPlantAndEquipmentPlantInService
concepts.review_reason: Despite the plant-in-service name, the official documentation describes total gross utility PP&E; confirm whether construction work in progress is excluded before adding it.

concepts.name: us-gaap:PublicUtilitiesPropertyPlantAndEquipmentAccumulatedDepreciation
concepts.review_reason: Utility accumulated depreciation can be included in general PP&E accumulated DD&A; the utility net balance already reflects this deduction.

children.label: Public utilities property plant and equipment fuel

concepts.name: us-gaap:PublicUtilitiesPropertyPlantAndEquipmentFuel
concepts.review_reason: This utility fuel amount is held as PP&E and can include nuclear fuel; it differs from fuel inventory and may overlap the nuclear-fuel net balance.

children.label: Combined ppe finance lease assets
children.classification_note: This aggregate can contain standalone PP&E and finance lease ROU assets; do not add the component asset populations again.

children.label: PP&E and finance ROU assets net

concepts.name: us-gaap:PropertyPlantAndEquipmentAndFinanceLeaseRightOfUseAssetAfterAccumulatedDepreciationAndAmortization
concepts.review_reason: Combined net PP&E and finance ROU assets can include the separate net PP&E and finance ROU amounts; choose one consistent population.

children.label: Noncurrent lease assets
children.classification_note: Finance ROU can already be in a PP&E combined total. Operating ROU assets differ from the lessor inventory and utility plant population.

children.label: Operating lease right of use asset
Finance lease right of use asset
Goodwill and intangible views
children.classification_note: Finite-lived and other intangibles can be included in intangibles excluding goodwill. Accumulated amortization is already reflected in net amounts; goodwill remains distinct.

concepts.name: us-gaap:FiniteLivedIntangibleAssetsAccumulatedAmortization
concepts.review_reason: Finite-lived accumulated amortization is already reflected in finite-lived intangible assets net; it does not establish gross intangible value by itself.

children.label: Noncurrent regulatory asset views
children.classification_note: Noncurrent regulatory assets can include securitized stranded-cost transition assets; securitization does not remove the regulatory asset or net it against debt.

concepts.name: us-gaap:SecuritizedRegulatoryTransitionAssetsNoncurrent
concepts.review_reason: Securitized transition assets are noncurrent regulatory stranded costs financed by debt; they can be included in regulatory assets and are not a deduction from debt.

children.label: Noncurrent derivative assets
children.classification_note: Noncurrent derivative and hedge asset concepts can overlap and depend on issuer scope/netting.

concepts.name: us-gaap:DerivativeInstrumentsAndHedgesNoncurrent
concepts.review_reason: This noncurrent derivative/hedge asset can overlap the separately supplied DerivativeAssetsNoncurrent measure; reconcile instrument scope before aggregation.

children.label: Noncurrent restricted cash and deposits
children.classification_note: Restricted cash/equivalents and restricted cash/investments can contain the cash-only balance; posted deposits are distinct from deposit liabilities.

children.label: Restricted cash and cash equivalents noncurrent

concepts.name: us-gaap:RestrictedCashAndInvestmentsNoncurrent
concepts.review_reason: Noncurrent restricted cash and investments can contain restricted cash/equivalents, trusts and investment amounts supplied separately; establish fund coverage.

children.label: Noncurrent tax and benefit assets
children.classification_note: Deferred tax assets are jurisdictionally net measures. Defined-benefit plan assets for plan benefits are not interchangeable with corporate cash or pension liabilities.

children.label: Defined benefit plan assets for plan benefits noncurrent
Noncurrent receivables
children.classification_note: The noncurrent allowance is already reflected in the matching net receivable balance; keep portfolio-specific allowances distinct.

children.label: Allowance for doubtful accounts receivable noncurrent

concepts.name: us-gaap:AllowanceForDoubtfulAccountsReceivableNoncurrent
concepts.review_reason: The noncurrent receivable allowance is already included in net noncurrent receivables and differs from the unsplit premium/other-receivable allowance.

children.label: Noncurrent deferred and other assets
children.classification_note: DeferredCosts explicitly excludes customer-contract costs and is noncurrent. Deferred finance costs may be debt deductions; regulated and miscellaneous residual assets can be included in broader other noncurrent assets.

concepts.name: us-gaap:DeferredFinanceCostsNoncurrentNet
concepts.review_reason: Noncurrent deferred financing costs can be eligible facility assets or debt deductions; confirm arrangement and avoid adding costs already netted in debt.

children.label: Assets with unresolved maturity
children.classification_note: These measures have no supported current/noncurrent split. Keep them outside classified subtotals until issuer scope resolves maturity; this hierarchy never implies addition.

children.label: Unsplit cash and collateral assets
children.classification_note: Cash/equivalent and cash-only restrictions overlap classified balances. Derivative collateral rights and margin deposits require netting and cash-role evidence.

children.label: Restricted cash and cash equivalents at carrying value

concepts.name: us-gaap:RestrictedCashAndCashEquivalentsAtCarryingValue
concepts.review_reason: Restricted cash and equivalents have no explicit maturity split; they can include separately classified restricted cash balances.

concepts.name: us-gaap:RestrictedCash
concepts.review_reason: Restricted cash alone has unresolved maturity and is narrower than restricted cash plus equivalents; do not add the unsplit amount to its maturity components.

children.label: Derivative collateral right to reclaim cash

concepts.name: us-gaap:DerivativeCollateralRightToReclaimCash
concepts.review_reason: This right to reclaim derivative cash collateral is not offset against derivative liabilities; determine maturity and netting presentation before combining with derivative assets or cash.

concepts.name: us-gaap:MarginDepositAssets
concepts.review_reason: Margin deposits may be restricted cash or other collateral assets; determine ownership, cash classification and maturity from issuer disclosures.

children.label: Unsplit receivables and contract assets
children.classification_note: Trade, other, financing and unbilled contract claims differ; unresolved maturity must not be inferred solely from the word receivable.

concepts.name: us-gaap:AccountsReceivableNet
concepts.review_reason: Net accounts receivable has no maturity restriction and can contain the current and noncurrent receivables reported separately.

concepts.name: us-gaap:OtherReceivables
concepts.review_reason: Other receivables have unresolved maturity and may include the current other-receivable balance supplied separately.

concepts.name: us-gaap:NotesReceivableNet
concepts.review_reason: Net notes receivable is an amortized-cost financing receivable with no explicit maturity restriction; do not assume it is wholly long-term.

concepts.name: us-gaap:UnbilledContractsReceivable
concepts.review_reason: Unbilled contract receivables are not necessarily current or equivalent to ASC 606 contract assets; identify billing conditions and maturity.

concepts.name: us-gaap:ContractWithCustomerAssetNet
concepts.review_reason: Net customer-contract assets have unresolved maturity and may include the current contract-asset balance supplied separately; they differ from unconditional receivables.

concepts.name: us-gaap:AllowanceForDoubtfulAccountsReceivable
concepts.review_reason: The unsplit allowance covers premium and other receivables under its definition; confirm the portfolio and maturity before applying it to utility trade receivables.

children.label: Unsplit investment assets
children.classification_note: Other and marketable investments can overlap current/noncurrent holdings; unquoted equity has a distinct measurement basis.

concepts.name: us-gaap:OtherInvestments
concepts.review_reason: Other investments have unresolved maturity and can include the other long-term investment balance; identify exclusions from broader investment totals.

concepts.name: us-gaap:MarketableSecurities
concepts.review_reason: Marketable securities have no current/noncurrent split and can include the maturity-specific security balances supplied separately.

children.label: Equity securities without quoted fair value

concepts.name: us-gaap:EquitySecuritiesWithoutReadilyDeterminableFairValueAmount
concepts.review_reason: Equity securities without readily determinable fair values have unresolved maturity and measurement adjustments; do not equate them with quoted marketable securities.

children.label: Unsplit regulatory deferred and other assets
children.classification_note: Unsplit regulatory assets can be individual schedule balances. Deferred offering costs may be equity deductions, and deferred/other aggregates overlap narrower assets.

concepts.name: us-gaap:RegulatoryAssets
concepts.review_reason: RegulatoryAssets denotes an individual regulatory asset in a schedule, not necessarily the issuer total or a noncurrent-only amount.

concepts.name: us-gaap:DeferredOfferingCosts
concepts.review_reason: Deferred offering costs relate to proposed or actual securities offerings; asset versus equity deduction and maturity depend on offering status and issuer presentation.

concepts.name: us-gaap:OtherDeferredCostsNet
concepts.review_reason: Other deferred costs net exclude financing costs and insurance acquisition costs but do not establish maturity; distinguish them from explicitly noncurrent deferred costs.

concepts.name: us-gaap:DeferredCostsAndOtherAssets
concepts.review_reason: Deferred costs and other assets combine multiple asset types with unresolved maturity; the balance can overlap narrower deferred-cost and other-asset measures.

concepts.name: us-gaap:OtherAssets
concepts.review_reason: OtherAssets has no maturity restriction and may contain both current and noncurrent residual assets.

concepts.name: us-gaap:AssetsOfDisposalGroupIncludingDiscontinuedOperation
concepts.review_reason: The disposal-group asset amount has no current/noncurrent restriction; it can contain the current disposal-group balance supplied separately.

children.label: Current finance cost presentation candidates
children.classification_note: These costs are explicitly current but need issuer evidence of eligible asset presentation versus deduction from debt; retain outside primary asset subtotals pending that review.

concepts.name: us-gaap:DeferredFinanceCostsCurrentNet
concepts.review_reason: Current deferred financing costs require confirmation of facility-asset versus debt-deduction presentation; explicit current classification does not by itself establish an asset.

children.label: Current debt views
children.classification_note: DebtCurrent includes leases, short-term borrowing and current maturities. Commercial paper, bank loans, credit lines and notes may be components rather than additional borrowing populations.

concepts.name: us-gaap:DebtCurrent
concepts.review_reason: Current debt includes leases and short-term borrowing as well as current maturities of originally long-term debt; do not add these components again.

children.label: Current long term debt and capital leases
Short term bank loans and notes payable
Current lease liabilities
children.classification_note: Lease obligations can already be included in current debt-and-lease aggregates; use matching scope.

children.label: Current payables and accruals
children.classification_note: Combined payables/accrual amounts overlap standalone payable, accrued-liability, interest, construction and residual balances. Establish exclusions before combining.

children.label: Accounts payable and accrued liabilities current
Accounts payable and other accrued liabilities current
Current employee and benefit liabilities
children.classification_note: Employee accruals can contain deferred share compensation and benefit obligations. Current pension/postretirement balances differ from noncurrent funded status.

children.label: Current tax liabilities
children.classification_note: All current taxes can contain current income tax and other-than-income tax accruals; these are overlapping aggregate and component views.

children.label: Accrual for taxes other than income taxes current
Current regulatory liabilities
children.classification_note: This concept can be an individual liability in a regulatory schedule, not necessarily the current regulatory liability total.

concepts.name: us-gaap:RegulatoryLiabilityCurrent
concepts.review_reason: The official definition describes an individual current regulatory liability in an itemized schedule; do not assume this fact is the full current regulatory liability total.

children.label: Current derivative liabilities
children.classification_note: Current derivative liabilities overlap derivative/hedge liabilities, whose definition is current and net of master netting.

concepts.name: us-gaap:DerivativeInstrumentsAndHedgesLiabilities
concepts.review_reason: The official definition makes this a current derivative/hedge liability net of master netting; reconcile scope with DerivativeLiabilitiesCurrent.

children.label: Current customer and distribution obligations
children.classification_note: Deferred revenue can include customer-contract liabilities; dividends payable are unpaid distributions, not cash payments.

children.label: Current retirement contingencies and other
children.classification_note: ARO, loss contingencies, acquisition consideration and residual liabilities may be included in broader current liability balances. Retirement liabilities differ from employee retirement benefits.

children.label: Loss contingency accrual carrying value current
Current disposal liabilities
children.classification_note: Current disposal-group liabilities can contain balances previously presented in individual liability categories.

children.label: Noncurrent debt views
children.classification_note: The unsuffixed debt-and-capital-lease concept is noncurrent by definition. Unsecured debt, other debt and credit lines overlap debt maturity aggregates.

concepts.name: us-gaap:LongTermDebtAndCapitalLeaseObligations
concepts.review_reason: The official definition restricts this debt-and-capital-lease amount to noncurrent obligations despite the absence of a Noncurrent suffix.

children.label: Noncurrent lease liabilities
children.classification_note: Noncurrent finance and operating leases may be included in broader debt/lease aggregates; avoid duplicating principal.

children.label: Noncurrent regulatory liabilities
children.classification_note: The regulatory liability can be an individual schedule balance. Accumulated deferred investment tax credit is explicitly a noncurrent regulatory credit reserve; identify inclusion in other regulatory balances.

concepts.name: us-gaap:RegulatoryLiabilityNoncurrent
concepts.review_reason: The official definition describes an individual noncurrent regulatory liability in an itemized schedule; establish whether the issuer fact is a component or a face-statement aggregate.

children.label: Noncurrent tax liability views
children.classification_note: Deferred-and-other tax liability aggregate can contain net deferred taxes and uncertain tax positions. Regulatory-related deferred tax is an attribution of tax liability, not an extra regulatory liability.

children.label: Noncurrent deferred and other tax liabilities

concepts.name: us-gaap:DeferredIncomeTaxesAndOtherTaxLiabilitiesNoncurrent
concepts.review_reason: This noncurrent aggregate includes deferred income taxes and other tax liabilities, so it can contain the separate deferred tax and uncertain-tax-position balances.

concepts.name: us-gaap:DeferredTaxLiabilitiesRegulatoryAssetsAndLiabilities
concepts.review_reason: This is deferred tax liability attributable to regulatory assets and liabilities, not a regulatory liability total or an extra tax liability beyond the matching deferred tax aggregate.

children.label: Liability for uncertain tax positions noncurrent
Noncurrent benefit liability views
children.classification_note: Combined pension/postretirement obligations overlap separate pension and other postretirement measures; select aggregate or reconciled components.

children.label: Defined benefit pension plan liabilities noncurrent
Other postretirement defined benefit plan liabilities noncurrent
Noncurrent retirement and contingency liabilities
children.classification_note: Asset retirement obligations are legal dismantlement/restoration liabilities, distinct from pensions and from decommissioning trust assets; funding does not automatically offset the liability.

children.label: Loss contingency accrual carrying value noncurrent
Noncurrent customer obligations
children.classification_note: Noncurrent customer-contract liabilities may be included in deferred credits; do not add the same obligation in both presentations.

children.label: Noncurrent derivatives and residual liabilities
children.classification_note: Nondebt liabilities can include regulatory, tax, pension, ARO, derivative and other obligations; it is an alternative aggregate, not residual other liabilities.

children.label: Liabilities other than longterm debt noncurrent

concepts.name: us-gaap:LiabilitiesOtherThanLongtermDebtNoncurrent
concepts.review_reason: Noncurrent liabilities excluding long-term debt can include regulatory liabilities, pensions, ARO, leases and taxes; it is not a residual other-liability component.

children.label: Noncurrent disposal liabilities
children.classification_note: Noncurrent disposal-group liabilities can contain balances reclassified from individual liability categories.

children.label: Liabilities with unresolved maturity
children.classification_note: Unsplit obligations can include both classified maturity portions and are not additive to those portions.

children.label: Unsplit debt and lease views
children.classification_note: Originally long-term debt/notes and pollution-control bonds include current maturities. Finance lease liability contains both maturity portions.

concepts.name: us-gaap:LongTermDebt
concepts.review_reason: Long-term debt includes current maturities and is net of debt adjustments; it must not be assigned wholly to noncurrent debt.

concepts.name: us-gaap:NotesPayable
concepts.review_reason: Notes payable includes current and noncurrent portions of originally long-term notes; it is not an exclusively current borrowing balance.

concepts.name: us-gaap:LongtermPollutionControlBondCurrentAndNoncurrent
concepts.review_reason: Pollution-control bonds include current and noncurrent portions and overlap maturity-based debt aggregates; financing purpose does not establish a distinct additive debt class.

concepts.name: us-gaap:FinanceLeaseLiability
concepts.review_reason: The finance-lease obligation is an all-maturity present value and includes current and noncurrent portions supplied separately.

children.label: Unsplit regulatory and deferred liabilities
children.classification_note: Individual regulatory liability and combined deferred-credit/residual measures do not establish maturity or aggregate scope.

concepts.name: us-gaap:RegulatoryLiabilities
concepts.review_reason: RegulatoryLiabilities denotes an individual regulatory liability in a schedule, with maturity unresolved; it is not automatically the sum of current and noncurrent regulatory liabilities.

concepts.name: us-gaap:DeferredCreditsAndOtherLiabilities
concepts.review_reason: Deferred credits and other liabilities combine unearned income and residual obligations with no explicit maturity split; do not assume all amounts are noncurrent.

children.label: Unsplit collateral accrual and disposal liabilities
children.classification_note: Derivative collateral return obligations, all-maturity interest and contingencies can overlap classified obligations; disposal totals can include both maturity portions.

children.label: Derivative collateral obligation to return cash

concepts.name: us-gaap:DerivativeCollateralObligationToReturnCash
concepts.review_reason: This obligation to return derivative cash collateral is not offset against derivative assets; maturity and netting treatment require issuer evidence.

concepts.name: us-gaap:InterestPayableCurrentAndNoncurrent
concepts.review_reason: Interest payable includes current and noncurrent portions and may contain the separate current interest accrual.

children.label: Loss contingency accrual at carrying value

concepts.name: us-gaap:LossContingencyAccrualAtCarryingValue
concepts.review_reason: The loss-contingency accrual has no maturity split and can contain the current and noncurrent contingency accruals supplied separately.

concepts.name: us-gaap:LiabilitiesOfDisposalGroupIncludingDiscontinuedOperation
concepts.review_reason: The unsplit disposal-group liability amount can contain both current and noncurrent disposal-group liabilities supplied separately.

children.label: Share capital views
children.classification_note: Common and preferred carrying/outstanding values are alternatives. Shares and per-share face amounts remain supplementary.

concepts.name: us-gaap:CommonStockValueOutstanding
concepts.review_reason: Common stock value outstanding can overlap common stock carrying value; identify issued versus outstanding and treasury treatment.

concepts.name: us-gaap:PreferredStockValueOutstanding
concepts.review_reason: Preferred stock value outstanding can overlap preferred stock carrying value; select the issuer capital presentation.

children.label: Paid in capital views
children.classification_note: All-class additional paid-in capital can contain common-only capital; do not add the narrower view again.

children.label: Additional paid in capital common stock
Retained earnings and oci
children.classification_note: Retained deficit and accumulated OCI signs follow issuer facts; no automatic sign reversal.

children.label: Accumulated other comprehensive income loss net of tax
Treasury stock views
children.classification_note: All-class treasury cost can contain common-only cost. Both are deductions already reflected in reported equity and do not imply a negative share count.

concepts.name: us-gaap:TreasuryStockCommonValue
concepts.review_reason: Common treasury-stock carrying cost is contained in all-class treasury stock and is already deducted from equity; do not deduct both views.

nodes.label: Temporary and redeemable equity
nodes.classification_note: Parent temporary equity and redeemable NCI are distinct ownership claims; redemption terms determine presentation outside permanent equity.

children.label: Temporary equity carrying amount attributable to parent

concepts.name: us-gaap:TemporaryEquityCarryingAmountAttributableToParent
concepts.review_reason: Parent temporary equity depends on redemption terms and is distinct from permanent parent equity and redeemable noncontrolling interests.

nodes.label: Supplementary disclosures
nodes.classification_note: Nonmonetary values, duration share movements, fair-value disclosures, combined capitalization and commitments are outside primary monetary balance totals.

children.label: Shares and per share disclosures
children.classification_note: Authorized, issued, outstanding and treasury shares differ. No-par common stock is officially per-share face amount, not aggregate capital.

children.label: Common stock par or stated value per share
Preferred stock par or stated value per share

concepts.name: us-gaap:CommonStockNoParValue
concepts.review_reason: The official schema and definition specify face amount per share for no-par common stock, not aggregate common-stock carrying value.

children.label: Share award movements
children.classification_note: Options forfeited are a duration share movement, not an instant balance-sheet quantity.

concepts.name: us-gaap:ShareBasedCompensationArrangementByShareBasedPaymentAwardOptionsForfeituresInPeriod
concepts.review_reason: Options forfeited during the period are a duration share movement, not reporting-date shares outstanding or a monetary balance-sheet asset.

children.label: Fair value and capitalization disclosures
children.classification_note: Fair-value investment disclosure may duplicate carrying holdings; capitalization combines debt and equity and is not an additional financing component.

concepts.name: us-gaap:InvestmentsFairValueDisclosure
concepts.review_reason: Investment fair value is a disclosure measurement and may differ from carrying amount or duplicate recognized holdings.

children.label: Long term debt and equity capitalization

concepts.name: us-gaap:CapitalizationLongtermDebtAndEquity
concepts.review_reason: Capitalization combines long-term debt and equity and overlaps both sides of the financing presentation; retain it outside primary liability and equity additions.

children.label: Commitment disclosures
children.classification_note: A monetary commitment disclosure does not establish recognized liability carrying value.

concepts.name: us-gaap:CommitmentsAndContingencies
concepts.review_reason: Commitments and contingencies do not establish a separately recognized liability; keep this disclosure outside recognized liability totals.
